notes.title: Wild Blue really does look like Star Fox and that has me excited
notes.notes:
I have fond memories of blasting through Star Fox 64 and Wild Blue might end up being the closest thing to it on PC.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/wild-blue-really-does-look-like-star-fox-and-that-has-me-excited/

notes.title: Wild Blue Gameplay Trailer Revealed!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537033/421496dcc7e102d79e426f43ee10733a56bfb8ee.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re super excited to finally show you the gameplay for [b]Wild Blue[/b]! We debuted a tease at Future Games Show; but right here, right now we can hit you with the full-length trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="mFzYMGiSrfw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537033/d92104404192239fe5812b4c60abfd0bfe85007e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now, without further ado, introducing the Blue Bombers…![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537033/d6222c5e24656b2486b2a8724f0229bf58ad97f7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537033/d92104404192239fe5812b4c60abfd0bfe85007e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🐕 Bowie Stray[/b] - The brave and cocky leader of the Blue Bombers, he's the pilot you'll control throughout Wild Blue![/p][p][b]🦌 Roe Whitetail[/b] - The lethal and exacting fighter who holds herself, and the team, to the highest of standards![/p][p][b]🦎 Thorne Prickle [/b]- The overly confident rookie who likes to run his mouth and show off, often landing him into trouble![/p][p][b]🐄 Chuck Barbacoa[/b] - The oldest and wisest of the bunch. He acts like a father figure to his teammates, protecting them in times of need.[/p][p]Expect to see and hear more about our Blue Bombers in future Steam posts 🥳[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537033/d92104404192239fe5812b4c60abfd0bfe85007e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We also shared a sneak peek at what Wild Blue will offer gameplay-wise 🎮[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537033/3f95f0d1ecb9b3ee837c2cf0ffae523f34df541b.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Classic on-rails missions with fighter pilot gameplay echoing the spirit of 90s shooters[/p][/*][*][p]Diverse and beautiful environments spread across missions in the world you will be saving[/p][/*][*][p]Fully-voiced characters, with banter between the team members throughout missions[/p][/*][*][p]Set-piece moments within missions, like helping out teammates or acrobatic environmental challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Epic boss battles against wild characters that act as a crescendo to every mission [/p][/*][*][p]Free-flight missions, complete with intense dogfights against a mysterious rival crew[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537033/d92104404192239fe5812b4c60abfd0bfe85007e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There’s a load more to reveal about [b]Wild Blue[/b] in the coming months, so please stay tuned for more information! We hope you love what you’ve seen so far and don’t forget to wishlist the game and follow Chuhai Labs on socials. [/p][p]

notes.title: Wild Blue Teaser Released!
notes.notes:
We’re so excited to show you the [i]teenies[/i]t bit of what we’ve been working on! Having Giles Goddard as our founder, we’ve wanted to make something that pays tribute to his amazing career making legendary games for a while now. With [b]Wild Blue[/b] we are making that dream a reality! We can’t wait to share more about this love letter to 90s on-rails aerial adventures soon! 

Stay Tuned! 

<3 Team Chuhai Labs
